programmes.d: The squad must work quickly to track down a serial killer before he strikes again. Things get dangerous over a game of chess. MALCOLM-JAMAL WARNER appears as Lt. Chuck Cooper.
Season finale: The squad draws closer to finding a dangerous serial killer. Rusty faces his biggest challenge as he takes the stand against Stroh. JERI RYAN, JON TENNEY guest star.
In the season premiere, when a father and his two young children go missing, the squad has to work quickly to find them, uncovering a slew of terrible family secrets along the way.
A murder victim's case is reopened and the squad works hard to solve a 17-year-old murder. EVER CARRADINE guest stars as Rusty's mother, Sharon Beck.
Gibbs and the team investigate when McGee's fictional book about an NCIS agent becomes reality. McGee is horrified when a Petty Officer on whom he based the character for his latest book is murdered.
Director Shepard takes a huge risk and agrees to meet an informant alone about Le Grenouille, but the meeting goes bad and her contact is killed.
Gibbs and the team investigate when a blind photographer inadvertently captures the murder of a petty officer on file.

Gibbs ignores the bureaucratic paperwork associated with his "acting" director duties and leads an investigation for a murder victim found in a taxi headed to NCIS headquarters. Meanwhile, Jenny discovers a secret about her past.
As the NCIS Director returns from a controversial European junket, and Gibbs and his agents reluctantly prepare for Homeland Security polygraph tests, tightly woven secrets among the team unravel.
While on Air Force One, a Navy Commander dies. Agents from NCIS decide to take the investigation into their own hands and also force Secret Service Agent Kate Todd to help. (TV-PG)

During a training exercise, a marine's parachute fails to open and he crashes into a parked car where two teenagers were making out. The NCIS team heads to the scene and has to determine if the marine's death was accidental or a murder. (TV-PG)
When a Navy commander's body washes up on shore along with the bodies of two drug runners, Gibbs refuses to believe that the sailor who was killed was dirty. (TV-PG)

The NCIS team investigates when a seaman's body is found at the bottom of the sea in his dress whites, with a ceremonial sword. They discover that he was addicted to a Wizards and Warriors style role-playing game. (TV-PG)

A Navy lieutenant who was reported missing nearly ten years ago has been found by a deer hunter. When the NCIS team arrives at the scene to investigate, they see that his remains have been mummified. (TV-PG)

An NCIS agent who used to work under Gibbs asks for the team's help investigating a case where sailors on an aircraft carrier are dying of a drug overdose, but have no history of any kind of drug abuse. (TV-PG)
A decomposed body is discovered in a tub of acid at a naval base and Ducky and Abby learn that the victim was a submariner.(TV-PG)
The team works to solve the murder of a dog that was left a $20 million estate by its deceased owner, with the help of a wannabe detective (ANDREW DALY - The Closer).

The violent murder of an alleged rapist gives the squad the emotional task of questioning suspects. Rusty catches his mom (EVER CARRADINE) in a lie and questions her motives.
When a foreigner is murdered, the squad tries to find the killer and avoid international repercussions after a U.S. diplomat becomes involved. Rusty tries to share a secret.
After a young runaway is murdered and thrown in a trash can, the Major Crimes unit is led on a long, puzzling hunt. TOM BERENGER guest stars as Raydor's estranged husband, Jack.
Major Crimes teams up with the LAPD's Special Operations Bureau to hunt a killer who is taking hostages. JON TENNEY, MALCOM-JAMAL WARNER, BILL BROCHTRUP, LAURIE HOLDEN guest star.
Tao finds himself doing double duty when the star of the cop show on which Tao serves as a consultant becomes the prime suspect in the murder of the star's biggest fan.
The murder of a tech entrepreneur with possible mob connections has the team working overtime. Rusty struggles to feel accepted when Raydor's son visits. JON TENNEY guest stars.
During an investigation, the LAPD finds itself in a turf battle between the Major Crimes division and the Special Operations Bureau. JON TENNEY, LAURIE HOLDEN guest star.
